mission.title: THE LAST SHIPMENT
mission.intro:
NOVA Technologies is preparing to launch a confidential project named Project ORION.

A few days before launch, Noor, a Cybersecurity Engineer at NOVA, discovered that sensitive files belonging to the project had been leaked. Noor began an internal investigation and discovered that the leak appeared to be connected to one of NOVA's outgoing equipment shipments.

On the night of the incident, Noor discovered that a copy of the stolen files was still inside the final shipment scheduled to leave the building at 10:00 PM. The shipment was originally scheduled for inspection at 9:30 PM, but Noor requested that the inspection be moved to 9:15 PM.

Before heading toward the shipping area, Noor sent a message to a colleague: "I found the missing files. They're still inside the building. I'm going to check the shipment before it leaves."

After that: NOOR DISAPPEARED. No exit from the building was recorded for her.

During the same period, cameras covering part of the shipping area were temporarily unavailable because of maintenance, and unusual activity was recorded in NOVA's internal access and shipment systems.

NOVA's internal investigation identified 20 suspects. All twenty are NOVA employees. Each has a different role, level of access and statement about what happened that night. There is currently no confirmed identity for the person responsible.
mission.phase2: Analyze the decrypted information and compare it with the Suspects Sheet (25 minutes).

ml.title: ML Forensic Audit
ml.intro: One continuous investigation with six locked stages.

leakage.name: Data Leakage
leakage.title: Stage 1 — Why is accuracy 96%?
leakage.prompt: Remove any feature that would not exist at prediction time.
leakage.passMessage: Leakage removed. Accuracy drops to 76%, exposing the real problem.
leakage.wrongMessage: One selected feature contains post-investigation information.

pipeline.name: Pipeline Repair
pipeline.title: Stage 2 — Repair the training pipeline
pipeline.prompt: Reorder the steps so preprocessing never learns from the test set.
pipeline.note: Hint: fitting preprocessing before the split leaks information.

evidence.name: Evidence Extraction
evidence.title: Stage 6 — Extract the evidence
evidence.prompt: Sort chronologically, then read the device suffix.

arduino.title: Security Controller Debugging
arduino.intro: Basic Arduino concepts only. The difficulty comes from reading a longer program and fixing interacting logic errors.
arduino.brief: Multiple logic bugs, incorrect conditions, wrong resets, and one missing behavior. No advanced libraries or advanced Arduino topics are required.
arduino.warning: Passing syntax is not enough. The hidden behavioral tests must all pass.
expectedBehaviour: Authorization button opens a 5-second safe window.
Door can open safely only during that window.
Motion counts only while the door is open.
After a valid entry, authorization must end cleanly.
The alarm stays on until Reset is pressed.
arduino.wrongMessage: Not all hidden tests pass yet.
arduino.outsideChangeMessage: A line outside the faulty logic was changed.

slot.prompt: // MISSING BEHAVIOR: when the door closes after a valid authorized entry, the authorization state should end cleanly.

options.code:
if (doorOpen && authorized) { entered = true; }
if (!doorOpen && entered) { authorized = false; entered = false; }

tests.name: Authorized opening does not trigger alarm
Motion counts only while door is open
